title: 第六百九十八章 机缘到来第六百九十七章 客人
content_zh:
第六百九十八章机缘到来
看着面前的这年轻人似乎放下了什么，那龟山甲是点了点头，随即笔走龙蛇，很快一张带着求真观元素的平安符，便已经绘制完成。
双手迅速交叠。
不一会儿，一张三角形的符纸便已经被他折叠好，被他放在了一个小小的锦囊之中，递给了张振东。
“平常的时候不要去污浊之地，也不要去碰水，看你的身份想必也能知晓，这些东西都是心里安慰……”
虽然早就已经知道，海城这一脉的这些祭司道人别具一格。
但是如今听到一个搞神学的道士跟他说，这玩意儿都是骗人的时候，他一时间也是有些绷不住。
按照道理来说。
你不应该给我传教，忽悠我嘛？
你这么做显得我很呆唉！
更重要的是。
他曾经看过一些内部的资料，里面隐隐约约显示，十村八寨还有求真观一脉，是真的有一点涉及到神秘莫测的东西的。
原本他还不太相信。
但是见到龟山甲这般表现，他突然有些相信了。
难不成这就是传说中的自信？
张振东不知道是个什么感觉，但是他只是感觉在这一刻面前的龟山甲，气质非常的特殊。
请了一张平安符。
张振东还去山上的那一个八卦炉旁边看了看。
如今八卦炉虽然摆在山上多年。
但是每逢雷雨，都有雷火祭炼。

现如今整个八卦炉还是金光灿灿的。
看着这一个庞大的八卦炉，又看了一番附近的景色之后，刘振东在夜色降临时却并未下山。
一直等到道观里都快没什么人的时候，他还不走。
见到这一幕。
一直原本坐在那里拿个小锤，在那叮叮敲着的黑木山，却是看了一眼面前这位公子哥:
“不知道这位居士有何需求？”
这小子最好有事。
要不然的话，他就会让对方知道他这一双铁拳的平等性。
上打权贵，下打刁民。
神权特许，先斩后奏。
懂不懂地区性宗教信仰头子的厉害？
越是地位高的，越是明白他们的非凡之处，所以他们收拾这些二代，那完全下手不留情。
有本事就去跟我的信仰说去吧！
虽然看着面前的道人好像是一副和蔼的模样，但是刘振东突然感觉自己后背有些发凉。
下意识打了个寒颤。
随即，那刘振东则是连忙开口说道:
“道长，听说道观之中允许留宿，不知道我们能不能有幸再次体验一番？”
听到了刘振东如此说，看着他这样一副好像没有什么恶意，单纯想要尝试一番的表情，黑木山上下打量了他一眼。
content_en:
Chapter 698: Opportunity Arrives
Seeing that the young man in front of him seemed to have put down something, the Turtle Mountain Armor nodded, and then he drew a dragon and snake. Soon, a peace talisman with elements of truth-seeking was completed.
Hands folded quickly.
After a while, a triangular piece of talisman paper was folded by him, placed in a small bag, and handed to Zhang Zhendong.
"Normally, don't go to dirty places, and don't touch water. I guess you can tell by your identity. These things are just comfort to my heart..."
Although it has been known for a long time that these priests and Taoists of Haicheng's lineage are unique.
But now when he heard a Taoist priest who practiced theology tell him that all this stuff was a lie, he couldn't hold back for a while.
Logically speaking.
Shouldn't you preach to me and fool me?
What you do makes me look stupid!
What's more.
He had seen some internal information, which vaguely showed that the Ten Villages and Eight Villages also had a branch of the Truth-seeking Guan, which was really involved in something mysterious and unpredictable.
At first he didn't quite believe it.
But seeing Guishan Jia behaving like this, he suddenly believed it.
Could it be that this is the legendary self-confidence?
Zhang Zhendong didn't know what it was like, but he just felt that the turtle in front of him at this moment had a very special temperament.
I asked for a peace charm.
Zhang Zhendong also went to take a look at the Bagua stove on the mountain.
Although the Bagua furnace has been placed on the mountain for many years.
But every time there is a thunderstorm, there are thunder and fire sacrifices.
Nowadays, the entire Bagua Furnace is still shining with golden light.
After looking at the huge Bagua furnace and the nearby scenery, Liu Zhendong did not go down the mountain when night fell.
He waited until there was almost no one in the Taoist temple, but he still didn't leave.
Saw this scene.
Heimushan, who had been sitting there holding a small hammer and banging it, glanced at the young master in front of him:
“I wonder what this layman’s needs are?”
This kid better be in trouble.
Otherwise, he will let the other party know the equality of his iron fists.
Beat the powerful at the top and the unruly people at the bottom.
It is a divine right charter, kill it first and then report it.
Do you understand the power of regional religious leaders?
The higher the status, the more they understand their extraordinary qualities, so they deal with these second generations without mercy.
If you have the ability, go ahead and speak out about my beliefs!
Although the Taoist in front of him seemed to be kind, Liu Zhendong suddenly felt a chill on his back.
I shuddered subconsciously.
Immediately, Liu Zhendong quickly spoke:
"Taoist Master, I heard that overnight stays are allowed in Taoist temples. I wonder if we can be lucky enough to experience it again?"
Hearing what Liu Zhendong said and seeing his expression as if he had no ill intentions and simply wanted to try something out, Heimushan looked him up and down.
